events.name: Inside Out Charleston
events.info: Inside Out Charleston returns October 21 for another night celebrating Charleston from the inside out through food, beverage, music, and community. This month, Tasting.edu presents Bourbon & Bubbles featuring Angel's Envy & Don Luchi Wines, an indulgent autumn bourbon salon with a sparkling twist. Angel Teta, Brand Ambassador for Angel's Envy, joins us in Charleston to lead an inspired exploration of seasonal cocktails featuring Angel's Envy bourbon and Don Luchi Wines. Expect a guided experience centered around Bourbon & Bubbles, with creative cocktails designed to inspire your fall entertaining and impress your guests. Tasting.edu: Bourbon & Bubbles featuring Don Luchi Wines is FREE, but RSVP is required and space is limited. Guests must also have an Inside Out Charleston entry ticket to participate. R3, Inc. celebrates 15 years of service in November. We're using the energy of Inside Out Charleston to give back, with a portion of the evening helping raise funds to support R3's ongoing community work and programming. And for the soundtrack, we're teaming up with Black People Love House Music for a night dedicated to KAYTRANADA. DJ tunes by @DJ_Nor_Way, bringing the house, dance, and feel-good energy all night. Tasting.edu: Bourbon & Bubbles featuring Don Luchi Wines Celebrating 15 Years of R3, Inc. KAYTRANADA Night x Black People Love House Music DJ Tunes by @DJ_Nor_Way October 21 | Inside Out Charleston The Refinery | 1640 Meeting Street
events.pleaseNote: All ticket sales are final. The Refinery is an outdoor venue open rain or shine. Please prepare accordingly.
